scope.purpose: Bounded read-only cost diagnosis from allowed development runs and formal aggregate reports; no tuning or new native tests.
scope.formal_reports_read: Aggregate paired/overall/structure_cost fields only for completed fold/push. Formal agent/tool/action trajectories and images were not inspected. Pour formal evaluation was still in progress.
scope.mutations: Only this diagnostic result; no source/protocol/worktree/run changes.

method.usage: Native CLI turn totals; uncached=input-cached. Reasoning is included within output. Actual billing/API request count unknown.
method.text_count: Recursively decode serialized MCP content wrappers before counting text; exclude base64 image data. Compact JSON used for attributable subfields. Character counts are not token estimates.
method.images: Count image content blocks and unique base64 payload hashes without decoding/viewing; log representation can differ from provider accounting.
method.rule_repetition: Exact rule.text strings repeated in initial prompt or earlier prepare/enter replies. Whole reused-context chars include references and metadata, not just duplicated rules.
method.code_inspection: Stage enter returns full context even on session cache reuse; assess echoes checks; observation responses append current execution attribution; execution_status returns full plan/progress only if called.

findings.claim: A reduction in control steps alone does not establish lower inference cost. Formal push has 4/4 matched successes and steps 1591 to 1273, but uncached input 290361 to 409502 (+41.0%) and output 45568 to 48237 (+5.9%).
findings.status: measured aggregate; no formal trace causal attribution

findings.claim: Formal fold cache fraction rises 95.67% to 96.49% while uncached input rises 340077 to 392691 (+15.5%). High cache percentage is compatible with higher absolute cost. Overall 2/4 counts conceal a failed case-preservation gate; only one pair is jointly successful.

Stage lifecycle adds substantial repeated nonvisual output: dev fold 17 calls/62808 response chars, push 18/66120, pour43 21/100879, pour815 25/119283. Legacy retrieval+planning was 2/2155, 6/5296, 3/2313, 8/4828 respectively.

In dev push, total decoded tool response text increased 69350 chars; lifecycle minus old retrieval/planning accounts arithmetically for 60824 (87.7%) of that text increase. This does not establish that 87.7% of token cost is caused by those fields.

Server cache reuse avoids retrieval computation but still returns full context. Reused-context responses total 19317/6189/32823/38775 chars across fold43/push43/pour43/pour815. Repeated rule text is 5076/9211/21084/25664 chars, even though task-global paragraphs were already in the initial prompt.
findings.status: observed mechanism; exact token savings of any change untested

findings.claim: Repeated full planning is not the observed cause: three 43 development episodes each create one plan with zero revision; pour815 uses one plan plus one explicit revision. Formal fold/push aggregates each contain four initial plans and zero revision.

Images do not uniformly explain higher cost. Dev push has 66 to 62 logged image blocks with unchanged 56 motion-feedback blocks but uncached input rises 85483 to 105283. Fold has 55 to 63 images and more control steps, so motion/observation volume confounds its protocol overhead.
findings.status: measured development associations, not formal causal explanation

findings.claim: execution_status was never called and episode-context.json was not read by logged command items in these eight runs. Its full-plan response is a potential future compaction overhead, not a demonstrated cause here.

The staged interface registers seven lifecycle tools replacing one record_plan tool, increasing static schema surface by six tools. Static schemas and initial prompts may affect input but provider prefix accounting is not exposed; no token attribution is available.

bounded_followups_for_a_future_registere: Prioritize a compact enter_stage acknowledgement when the same context is already available, retaining full guidance for first entry, changed references, or explicit context recovery. A server cache hit must not be mistaken for model context retention after compaction.

Consider compact assessment acknowledgements and one-time version metadata while keeping complete evidence/checks in the append-only ledger and recoverable state. Avoid echoing checks and plan-phase objects unchanged on every transition.

Measure real request-level token/cache attribution if provider instrumentation becomes available before further cache engineering. Exact-query cache hits are zero in these runs but per-stage context reuse works; speeding lexical BM25 or broadening semantic reuse has no demonstrated end-to-end cost value here.
limitations: Four candidate development episodes, only two matched legacy-success pairs, cannot causally explain the formal regression token increase.
No private evaluator state, images, formal regression trajectories or formal pour output were inspected; no protocol/code optimization or rerun was performed.
Tool calls are not API requests. Decoded text characters, image blocks and cache fractions cannot be converted into billed cost with the available logs.
Development timings and success outcomes differ; provider load and scenario trajectories confound comparisons. Preserve failures and missing usage rather than imputing zero.
